an3.26:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these three kinds of persons found existing in the world.
an3.26:1.3: (1) There is a person who is not to be associated with, followed, and served;
an3.26:1.4: (2) a person who is to be associated with, followed, and served;
an3.26:1.5: and (3) a person who is to be associated with, followed, and served with honor and respect.
an3.26:1.6: (1) “And what kind of person, bhikkhus, is not to be associated with, followed, and served?
an3.26:1.7: Here, some person is inferior to oneself in virtuous behavior, concentration, and wisdom.
an3.26:1.8: Such a person is not to be associated with, followed, and served except out of sympathy and compassion.
an3.26:2.1: (2) “And what kind of person is to be associated with, followed, and served?
an3.26:2.2: Here, some person is similar to oneself in virtuous behavior, concentration, and wisdom.
an3.26:2.3: Such a person is to be associated with, followed, and served.
an3.26:2.4: For what reason? Because one considers:
an3.26:2.5: ‘Since we are similar with regard to virtuous behavior, we will have a discussion on virtuous behavior, and it will flow on smoothly between us, and we will feel at ease.
an3.26:2.6: Since we are similar with regard to concentration, we will have a discussion on concentration, and it will flow on smoothly between us, and we will feel at ease.
an3.26:2.7: Since we are similar with regard to wisdom, we will have a discussion on wisdom, and it will flow on smoothly between us, and we will feel at ease.’
an3.26:2.8: Therefore such a person is to be associated with, followed, and served.
an3.26:3.1: (3) “And what kind of person is to be associated with, followed, and served with honor and respect?
an3.26:3.2: Here, some person is superior to oneself in virtuous behavior, concentration, and wisdom.
an3.26:3.3: Such a person is to be associated with, followed, and served with honor and respect.
an3.26:3.4: For what reason? Because one considers:
an3.26:3.5: ‘In such a way I will fulfill the aggregate of virtuous behavior that I have not yet fulfilled or assist with wisdom in various respects the aggregate of virtuous behavior that I have fulfilled.
an3.26:3.6: I will fulfill the aggregate of concentration that I have not yet fulfilled or assist with wisdom in various respects the aggregate of concentration that I have fulfilled.
an3.26:3.7: I will fulfill the aggregate of wisdom that I have not yet fulfilled or assist with wisdom in various respects the aggregate of wisdom that I have fulfilled.’
an3.26:3.8: Therefore such a person is to be associated with, followed, and served with honor and respect.
an3.26:3.9: “These, bhikkhus, are the three kinds of persons found existing in the world.”
an3.26:4.1: One who associates with an inferior person declines;
an3.26:4.2: one who associates with an equal does not decline;
an3.26:4.3: attending on a superior person one develops quickly;
an3.26:4.4: therefore you should follow one superior to yourself.
